name: image_options
description: Read the user's selected image provider/model, connection availability and image workflow. The user selects the billing account in Settings > Images; tools cannot change it. API account access is separate from chat subscription access.

name: generate_image
description: Generate or edit one image using the user's image provider in Settings > Images. Use only when the user requests an image or the task requires an image asset. Saves a new PNG in the working folder and an immutable version in Chat files, returning a link and preview markup. Include the returned preview in your reply to display the image inline. For edits pass reference image paths or owned Chat files IDs, and preserve the requested content in the prompt. Originals stay unchanged. Inspect the result with an image-capable tool/model before claiming visual verification. No automatic retries: cancellation or uncertain failure may still incur supplier charges.

destination.description: New PNG path inside the working folder. Parent folder must exist. Existing files cannot be overwritten.

references.description: Existing working-folder image paths or upload:/output: IDs from list_chat_files. PNG, JPEG or WebP; 25 MB combined.

transparent.description: True for cutouts or background removal. Requires an image connection supporting transparency.
